name: HEATWAVE ELEGY
source:
"The apocalypse came slowly, at first, like waves gently washing upon a shore."

The world has fallen into ruin. Everyone you love is dead.

As you were about to relocate from your desolate home, you come across a locket–

–And a “system” that appeared by your side.

[From [url=https://nqztan.itch.io/heatwave-elegy]itch.io[/url]]
